package: Escape_Panic_v02 (panic variants of Escape_v01, K10 case)
unity_import: same as Escape_v01: Generic, Copy From Other Avatar = SAUSAGE_BUDDY_A_v04Avatar, Anim. Compression Off; Loop Time on only for *_Loop_* clips
authoring_space: PatientRest (as v01): head +Y, face +Z, his LEFT = +X; Unity PatientRest-local = (-x, z, -y). Root motion: none (Apply Root Motion off), except the HopRun hand-off and the in-place run loop (see root_motion per clip)

run0_root.note: PatientRest-local Unity transform of the floor root that Flee_Run_v01 frame 1 expects (position (-x, z, -y) of armature space; rotation = -yaw about Unity +Y, sign flips with the handedness). Equivalently table-local: PatientRest @ this.

run0_root_L.note: PatientRest-local Unity transform of the floor root that Flee_Run_v01 frame 1 expects (position (-x, z, -y) of armature space; rotation = -yaw about Unity +Y, sign flips with the handedness). Equivalently table-local: PatientRest @ this.

chaining: Every v02 clip starts and ends on the same pose keys as its v01 counterpart (seam error 0), so v01 and v02 clips can be mixed freely in one escape.

Panic chain: [Esc_Lie_TugArmX_Loop_Panic_v02 x n] -> Esc_Lie_UnbuckleArmX_ByY_Panic_v02 -> Esc_SitUp_Panic_v02 -> [Esc_Sit_UnbuckleLeg(L|R|sBoth)_Panic_v02] -> Esc_SwingOff_(R|L)_Panic_v02 -> Esc_HopRun_(R|L)_BellyClutch_v02 -> Esc_Run_BellyClutch_Loop_Panic_v02 (free NPC root at RUN0 / RUN0_L, 3.2 m/s; or Flee_Run_v01 with a ~0.2 s crossfade).
Esc_HopRun_*_BellyClutch_v02 ends on RUN0_BC / RUN0_BC_L = Esc_Run_BellyClutch_Loop_Panic_v02 frame 1 at the v01 RUN0 / RUN0_L root (same root, yaw and 3.2 m/s as v01).
StrapOpen times are identical to v01 (only the clip lengths changed): ARM 1.40 s, LEG one 1.35 s, LegsBoth R 1.08 s / L 1.42 s.

chains_to: Esc_Run_BellyClutch_Loop_Panic_v02 (loop) on the free NPC root placed at RUN0_L (= RUN0_L of v01), moving 3.2 m/s along its facing

events.name: HandOffToRun
events.note: end pose = Esc_Run_BellyClutch_Loop_Panic_v02 frame 1 at RUN0_L

Esc_HopRun_L_BellyClutch_v02.interrupt: t < 0.30 -> Esc_Slump_Edge_L_v01; 0.47 <= t <= 0.98 -> Esc_Stumble_Off_L_Panic_v02 (or _v01); 0.30-0.47 and > 0.98: ragdoll / capture flow
Esc_HopRun_L_BellyClutch_v02.root_motion: hips leave the table (PatientRest-local); final hand-off root RUN0_L (see esc_pose_keys_v01.json run0_root_L_patientrest_unity); speed at the end 3.2 m/s along the facing

chains_to: Esc_Run_BellyClutch_Loop_Panic_v02 (loop) on the free NPC root placed at RUN0 (= RUN0 of v01), moving 3.2 m/s along its facing

events.name: HandOffToRun
events.note: end pose = Esc_Run_BellyClutch_Loop_Panic_v02 frame 1 at RUN0

Esc_HopRun_R_BellyClutch_v02.interrupt: t < 0.30 -> Esc_Slump_Edge_R_v01; 0.47 <= t <= 0.98 -> Esc_Stumble_Off_R_Panic_v02 (or _v01); 0.30-0.47 and > 0.98: ragdoll / capture flow (same windows as v01)
Esc_HopRun_R_BellyClutch_v02.root_motion: hips leave the table (PatientRest-local); final hand-off root RUN0 (see esc_pose_keys_v01.json run0_root_patientrest_unity); speed at the end 3.2 m/s along the facing

Esc_Lie_TugArmR_Loop_Panic_v02.root_motion: none: rig object at PatientRest, the Hips curves place the body (Apply Root Motion off)
